fun_facts: His full name is DeKaylin Zecharius “DK” Metcalf.
At Oxford High School, DK Metcalf played football, basketball and track, and set the school's triple-jump record.
In high school, DK Metcalf was a standout hurdler and long-jumper and ran on Oxford High School’s 4x100-meter relay team.
At the NFL Combine, DK Metcalf ran the 40-yard dash in 4.33 seconds and completed 27 reps on the 225-pound bench press.
DK Metcalf set an NFL rookie postseason record with a 160-yard receiving game in a playoff win over the Eagles.
DK Metcalf caught 83 passes for 1,303 yards in a Pro Bowl season, setting Seattle’s single-season franchise record for receiving yards.
